mapper.select: SELECT step_order `order`,step_code code,step_name name,status,completed_by completedBy,completed_at completedAt,note,detail_json detailJson FROM bike_pi_workflow_step WHERE pi_id=#{piId} ORDER BY step_order

SELECT step_order `order`,step_code code,step_name name,status,completed_by completedBy,completed_at completedAt,note,detail_json detailJson FROM bike_pi_workflow_step WHERE pi_id=#{piId} ORDER BY step_order FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO bike_pi_workflow_step(pi_id,step_order,step_code,step_name,status) VALUES (#{piId},1,'PI_CREATED','建立 PI','PENDING'), (#{piId},2,'PAYMENT_CONFIRMED','等待并确认客户付款','PENDING'), (#{piId},3,'DOCUMENTS_READY','建立合同、收付款、生产表','PENDING'), (#{piId},4,'PRODUCTION_FOLLOW_UP','跟进工厂生产进度','PENDING'), (#{piId},5,'FORWARDER_SELECTED','联系货代询价并选择货代','PENDING'), (#{piId},6,'DOMESTIC_EXPRESS_BOOKED','预约工厂至货代的快递','PENDING'), (#{piId},7,'TRACKING_RECORDED','填写单号并跟踪运输','PENDING'), (#{piId},8,'CUSTOMER_RECEIVED','确认客户收货，完成订单','PENDING')
mapper.update: UPDATE bike_pi_workflow_step target INNER JOIN bike_pi_workflow_step source ON source.pi_id=#{previousPiId} AND source.step_order=target.step_order AND source.status='COMPLETED' SET target.status='COMPLETED',target.completed_by=source.completed_by,target.completed_at=source.completed_at, target.note=source.note,target.detail_json=source.detail_json WHERE target.pi_id=#{piId} AND target.status='PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT id,step_code stepCode,detail_json detailJson,note,created_by createdBy,created_at createdAt FROM bike_pi_workflow_update WHERE pi_id=#{piId} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC
